status: LOCKED BEFORE ANY RESULT WAS COMPUTED
research_question: Can an execution-aware filter, using only information available at decision time, convert the Alpha Core signal into a positive net edge after realistic costs?

prior_from_experiment_14.note: E14's ex_t1_unbuyable filter used FUTURE queue status. That is an oracle and no real filter can beat it. Its result is therefore an upper bound on this experiment.
prior_from_experiment_14.implication: The oracle bound at h=1 (0.397%) is already BELOW the round trip (1.039%). A decision-time filter is expected to fail. This is recorded before running so the outcome cannot be reinterpreted afterwards.

alpha_core.modifications_permitted: NONE — factors, weights, formula, ranking method, universe definition and selection logic are all frozen

execution_filter.placement: AFTER Alpha Core ranking, BEFORE portfolio construction
execution_filter.fitted_parameters: NONE — every threshold is a natural constant or an in-sample-free percentile
rules_exclude_a_name_if: it was locked at the band on session t (locked_up == true)
it closed at its high on session t with a positive move (closed_at_high == true)
its session-t volume exceeded 3x its own trailing 60-session median (volume_spike)
its ADV sits in the bottom quintile of the date's cross-section
it did not trade on session t (stale)
execution_filter.rationale: Each rule is a decision-time proxy for the t+1 queue state Experiment 14 measured. None references any future bar.

portfolio_construction.exposure: constant 100% of the sleeve — the retired exposure engine takes no part
portfolio_construction.rebalance: at each tested horizon, not assumed to be 20

execution_model.convention: T+1 — a name selected at the close of t is bought at t+1
execution_model.unbuyable_at_t1: locked_up OR reopen OR extreme_gap on session t+1
execution_model.slippage_note: held at zero deliberately, so the result is optimistic; a failure at zero slippage is a failure at any slippage

arms.A: Alpha Core top-10, no execution filter
arms.B: Alpha Core top-10 drawn from the filtered universe
arms.C: Random top-10 from the identical filtered universe, 30 seeds

metrics: queue exposure before and after the filter

G1_artifact_removal.criterion: Arm B queue exposure (share of the selected book locked on t+1) must fall to <= 1.5x the universe rate, from Arm A's measured 3.03x

G2_net_alpha.criterion: Arm B net annualised alpha must exceed Arm A's at the same horizon

G3_random_separation.criterion: Arm B must sit above the 95th percentile of the 30-seed Arm C distribution on net annualised alpha

G4_cost_survival.criterion: Arm B net alpha must be POSITIVE after the 1.039% round trip at at least one horizon

G5_statistical.criterion: Paired per-period difference B - C must have a block-bootstrap 95% CI excluding zero

G6_robustness.criterion: G2-G4 must hold at two or more horizons AND in at least 3 of 4 sub-periods (2014-2016, 2017-2019, 2020-2022, 2023-2024)

decision_rule.FAIL: any gate fails -> ARCHIVE SIRAT-AI TRADING SPECIFICATION
decision_rule.INVALID: any confirmed leakage, accounting error or exposure inequality between arms

prohibited: modifying Alpha Core in any way
tuning the filter thresholds after seeing results
adding filter rules after seeing results
changing the basket size or horizon set after seeing results
